payload.name: Invoice Variance Log
payload.description: What has happened to an invoice's variances (#648), append-only. An Admin accepts a Price variance, a Quantity variance or Totals differ with a reason (Accepted); an edit that changes the two figures it was accepted on while the variance still stands opens it again (Reopened), and one that leaves no variance clears it (Cleared). Each acceptance's state is cached on its row — Invoice Items."Price Variance Accepted" and "Quantity Variance Accepted", Invoices."Totals Differ Accepted" — written by lib/variance.server.js with the row that moved it, never by a formula.

fields.name: Invoice Variance Log ID
fields.description: {Invoice ID}-{seq}, three digits, minted by lib/idSequence.server.js:generateChildId (Invoices::Invoice Variance Log) — a child of the invoice its variances are on.

fields.name: Invoice
fields.description: The invoice whose variance this row is about. One record, enforced by the app.

fields.name: Invoice Item
fields.description: The invoice item a Price variance or Quantity variance row is about; blank on a Totals differ row, which is the invoice's own. One record, enforced by the app.

fields.name: Variance
fields.description: Which of an invoice's three variances: Price variance (Invoice Items."Has Price Variance"), Quantity variance ("Has Quantity Variance") or Totals differ (Invoices."Totals Differ") — the screen's words (lib/variance.js).

fields.name: Event
fields.description: Accepted: an Admin accepted the variance, with a reason. Reopened: an edit changed the two figures it was accepted on and the variance still stands. Cleared: an edit left no variance. The last two end an acceptance; lib/variance.js:acceptanceAfter decides which.

fields.name: Reason
fields.description: Why the office accepted it, as the Admin typed it. Required on an Accepted row; blank on the others.

fields.name: Vendor Figure
fields.description: The invoice's side of the comparison when this row was written: the item's Unit Price (Price variance), the item's own Qty (Quantity variance) or Invoice Total (Totals differ).

fields.name: Our Figure
fields.description: The side it is held against when this row was written: the ordered item's Unit Price, the ordered item's Qty, or Calculated Total. An acceptance stands while both figures are what its Accepted row holds.

fields.name: Recorded By
fields.description: Who accepted it, or whose edit reopened or cleared it; blank where no person did, as when an overage correction's order is generated. One record, enforced by the app.

fields.name: Event At
fields.description: When it happened, UTC instant, *At convention.
